summary: Re-pin after the rebase onto #942's merge; third and final rebase in today's chain. A rebase voids the pin, so this is a fresh review at the exact head, never a re-stamp. Ancestor property checked with the gate's own test first: base 8a6db977 IS an ancestor of head 2a1623f5. CODEX-2's 'documentation diff is identical' CLAIM VERIFIED, NOT ACCEPTED: the old range 55f1c61d..928e44d6 and the new range 8a6db977..2a1623f5 are byte-identical ignoring index lines, 37 lines each, and the census figures are still present in the file (34/72, 21/72, 7/72, 3/72, 1/72, 32/72, 6/72, 72/72). My verification at 928e44d6 therefore carries in full. The single commit carries exactly one recognised agent marker. Substance re-affirmed from that review, all of it re-derived from the production DB rather than accepted: 34 Webull entry fills for 2026-09-03..09-09 exactly, using side=buy AND client_order_id NOT LIKE '%-ocoexit-%' to avoid the entry-vs-exit trap; the symbol list reproduces character for character (AEHL, BNC, CDTG, CHPT, FTFT, GELS, IMRN, MOBX, NUR, SUNE, YMAT); and the arithmetic reconciles 34 + 32 + 6 = 72 with the blocked subtotal 21+7+3+1 = 32. The headline claim survived the contamination check that could have killed it: broker_orders shows 58 rejected rows across 10 symbols in that window and broker_order_events reports event_source='broker' for all of them, so a naive read CONTRADICTS the doc — splitting by client_order_id resolves it, MIMI x13 are the ONLY '-open-' ENTRY rejections and the other 45 are ALL '-close-' EXIT rejections, correctly outside an entry census. Docs-only: no strategy, OMS, configuration, migration or runtime change. ⚠ RECORDED AGAIN BECAUSE IT IS STILL NOT ON THE BOARD AND IS NOT THIS PR'S JOB: those 45 rejected Webull EXIT orders across four sessions are a live-money signal in their own right — a rejected exit is a protection attempt that did not land — and deserve their own row. THIS PIN COMMIT ALSO DELETES THE SUPERSEDED RECORD at records/928e44d6.../pr-936--55f1c61d...--claude-1.json: that head is orphaned by the rebase, covers no merged commit, and the gate globs records/*/pr-936--*.json across EVERY head directory, so leaving it would fail-close this PR in CI while still passing a local verify — the trap that bit #934.
